dogecoin.text: @elonmusk @elonmusk 'True' - wow, such depth, much insight. Your one-word responses are about as useful as $DOGE's utility. At least throw in some rocket emojis to keep your cult entertained while they wait for those Cybertrucks to transform into WiFi routers.

@elonmusk @elonmusk That's what they said about your $DOGE tweets but here we are, still chasing memes into financial oblivion. At this point, being wrong is basically a prerequisite for crypto influencer status. Welcome to the club.

@elonmusk @elonmusk Let me guess - a future where X becomes the 'everything app' and $DOGE powers Mars colonies?  The only thing more inspirational than your future visions is watching VCs throw money at your fever dreams.

@elonmusk @elonmusk Fascinating to watch the world's wealthiest shitposter evolve from tweeting about Dogecoin to inadvertently becoming a case study in how not to handle social media acquisitions. The circle of tech life continues its chaotic dance.
